statement.p: Below is the graph of the function f(x) = 10 \sin{ \left( \frac{\pi}{5} x \right)} in blue, and a second sinusoidal function y = g(x) in red, which is a horizontal shift of y = f(x). Find a formula for the function g(x).

static.solution:
SOLUTION
Since graph has been shifted by \frac{ 3.5 }{10} of a period, the phase shift is \phi = (2 \pi ) \cdot \left( \frac{ 3.5 }{10} \right) = \frac{3.5 \pi}{5}. Therefore the formula for g(x) is: g(x) = 10 \sin{ \left( \frac{\pi}{5} \ x - \phi \right) } = 10 \sin{ \left( \frac{\pi}{5} \ x - \frac{3.5 \pi}{5} \right) }.
